chunks: And from him, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmud, who said:

I saw Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) bid farewell to the House (Kaaba). When he intended to exit from the door of the mosque, he prostrated, then stood up, faced the Kaaba, and said: 'O Allah, I am returning upon the basis that there is no god but You.'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Rida say when bidding farewell to the Kaaba?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the spiritual etiquette of concluding a pilgrimage, where Imam al-Rida (AS) demonstrates profound humility by prostrating before exiting the Masjid al-Haram. His supplication, 'O Allah, I return upon the basis that there is no god but You,' reflects the Shia emphasis on *tawhid* as the enduring state of the believer after ritual acts, linking the physical departure with spiritual continuity.
